We need DBE for C10H10ClNO2. DBE formula: DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 +1 (ignoring halogens). For halogen treat as H. So effective H = H + X = 10 + 1 (Cl) =11. Use formula: DBE = C - (H+X)/2 + N/2 +1 = 10 - 11/2 + 1/2 +1 = 10 -5.5 +0.5 +1 = 6. So DBE = 6. Integer.

We could retrieve formula via tool but we already know. But to be safe, we can call retrieve_dbe_formula.
